title: 第15章 你死定了，天王老子来了都没用
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 电话那头的袁爱琴也在听到陆阳声音的这一瞬，莫名的红了眼眶。儿行千里母担忧，更何况还是头回离家这么远去当兵。这些天，她是吃不好睡不好，人都瘦了好几斤，每天都盼着儿子能打个电话回来。夫妻俩从三侄儿那听说部队周末通常会发手机，于是从早上开始就一直守在电话前，寸步不敢离开。“儿子，部队里感觉怎么样，吃得好不好，睡得好不好，训练累不累？”“好，可好了，部队里伙食都是四菜一汤，饭后还有水果，比在家吃的还好呢。”“睡得也瓷实，白天训练完，晚上倒头就睡，中午还会给我们午休，夜里班长还给我们盖被子。”“我现在吃饭能吃好几碗，跑步能跑不少圈了；前两天，帮着指导员出黑板报，对了，我还当上副班长了.......”听闻陆阳在部队里一切都好，还当上了班干部，老俩口脸上满是笑意。但紧跟着，那头就传来一阵脚步声，还有堂哥略微不可置信的声音。“啥，副班长？”“陆阳，你都混上职务了？”听到堂哥诧异的声音，陆阳脸上多少带着点儿小骄傲。因为他知道，堂哥当兵那会儿，最后走的时候连个“四有”都没捞着。所以堂哥就很后悔的跟他说，当兵都是滚雪球，一步落后，步步落后。但凡他当时在新兵连积极表现，混个副班长，回头下连了去个教导队啥的，都不至于两年义务兵就灰溜溜的回来了。堂哥那头的声音酸溜溜的：“你小子，不是在这存心逗你哥吧？一个班八九个人，其余那么些都被你给比下去了？”陆阳见他不信，回头冲着宿舍里喊了一声。当听见电话那头传来的声音是：“班副，咋了？”堂哥这心彻底哇凉哇凉的：“不是，老弟啊，你，你咋混上的副班长？”陆阳哈哈一笑：“都你们之前教的好，我一进部队就积极表现，处处不踩雷，班长就觉得我特挺机灵。”听到这话，堂哥原本垂下的脑袋又再一次昂了过来：“老弟，好好干！新兵连当班副，下连当班长，回头考学上军校，搞个排长当当！”陆阳也是借他吉言，这也是他入伍以来，一直积极表现力争上游的主要原因。部队这个地方，只要你足够的努力拼搏，就能收获你想要的。体能好的，可以靠着破纪录，参加比武，获得荣誉。文采好的可以多写文章多发表，或者帮着出黑板报，混个文职干事轻轻松松。会炒菜的，炊事班那帮人都是争着抢着要，新训阶段哪怕内务和训练都是一坨狗屎，班排长见了你也是笑嘻嘻的。陆阳知道六班有个新兵，从新东方厨师学校毕业，有厨师证的那种。隔三差五的就去食堂帮厨，回来给班上新兵带吃的拿喝的。在他们班，那个兵几乎就是众星捧月一般的存在。所以，来了这就别藏着掖着，部队本就是个大显身手的舞台。堂哥离开了，电话重新回到父母手中，这回说话的是父亲陆勇强。与母亲不同，父亲的关心总是显得比较拘谨，还透着点儿正式和生硬。“在部队里要听班长的话，没和其他人闹什么矛盾？”“没有，大家都挺好的。”“班长让你来当班副，是信任和器重你，往后更得努力，不能骄傲.......”“好了好了，你跟儿子说这些干嘛，他自已不知道吗？去去去，上一边去，我跟儿子说话......”听着电话那头，母亲不厌其烦的叮嘱和关心，陆阳笑容都暖洋洋的。在父母眼里，孩子永远都是长不大的。年少不懂事，永远听不进父母唠叨。长大后才渐渐明白，这个世界上除了父母，没人会无条件的真心对你好。社会的边角料，父母的小骄傲，也只有父母才会关心你累不累，苦不苦，有没有好好吃饭。可太多人真正明白这个道理时，却发现岁月早已染透了他们的鬓角，压弯了他们的身子，模糊了他们在你记忆里的模样。“儿子，你能不能，拍张照发过来？妈想你的时候，能拿出来看看。”“妈，部队有规定，不能拍乱拍。”“哦，是这样啊.......”那头的母亲，明显有些失落，但陆阳却告诉她。“不过，我们班长说了，回头快下连的时候会给我们单独拍照，到时候我可以写信寄回去。”“行行行，那也行！”又简单聊了几句，询问了一下家里老人身体情况，得知一切安好后的陆阳也踏实放心许多。对于重生回来的陆阳而言，部队里的一切都是新奇的，也都是陌生的。之前所了解的一切，都是源自于堂哥和他两位战友的口述，还有网络上查到的资料。好在有系统辅助，能够帮助他更好的去探索和了解部队这个全新“人生副本”。这也让他对于接下来的生活愈发期待，尤其是下连以后的生活。将手机放回口袋，陆阳刚返回宿舍，就瞧见丁腾飞正用手机对着条令条例拍摄。当闪光灯亮起的那一刻，陆阳瞳孔猛地收缩，赶紧冲上去制止。“你在干什么？！”“关你屁事！”丁腾飞将陆阳扒拉到一旁，抬手准备对着宿舍环境再拍两张。但下一秒，手机就被一把夺走，气得他上去就要跟陆阳干架。“草，你特么找茬是吧？自已没手机啊，还给我！”“来个人把他拉开！”但还没等拳头碰到陆阳，就被好几个人给控制住。气的丁腾飞破口大骂，奋力挣扎：“草泥马，放开我！不撒手我弄死你们，全是特么的一条狗.......”孔垄上去就是一脑瓜子：“闭嘴，再动削你！”丁腾飞被一帮人死死按在床上，但嘴巴就跟淬了毒一样，咒骂声根本就没停过。陆阳根本就没去管他，焦急的翻看丁腾飞的相册，还有手机聊天记录。当他看到，好几个对话框里都出现了关于部队的“涉密”照片。以及qq空间里那条十分傻逼的军装自拍照，脸色瞬间难看到了极点。陆阳扭过头，看向还在地上奋力挣扎叫嚣的丁腾飞，深吸口气：“丁腾飞，你死定了，天王老子来了都没用，我说的......”丁腾飞嘴巴依旧不依不饶：“去你妈的，吓唬我，老子是吓大的？！”
content_en: Yuan Aiqin, who was on the other end of the phone, also had inexplicable red eyes at the moment she heard Lu Yang's voice.His mother was worried because his son had traveled thousands of miles, not to mention it was the first time he had gone so far away from home to join the army.These days, she couldn't eat well or sleep well, and she lost several pounds. She looked forward to a call from her son every day.The couple heard from their third nephew that the army usually distributes mobile phones on weekends, so they have been in front of the phone since the morning, not daring to leave."Son, how do you feel in the army? Do you eat well, sleep well, and are you tired from training?" "Okay, that's good. The food in the army is four dishes and one soup, and there is fruit after meals. It's better than what we eat at home." "I sleep well. After training during the day, I fall asleep at night. We are also given a lunch break at noon.The squad leader also covers us with quilts at night."Now I can eat several bowls and run a lot of laps. Two days ago, I helped the instructor with the blackboard report. By the way, I also became the deputy squad leader..." When they heard that Lu Yang was doing well in the army and became a class cadre, the old couple were full of smiles.But immediately after, there was a sound of footsteps from the other end, and a slightly disbelieving voice from my cousin."What, deputy squad leader?" "Lu Yang, you've already got a job?" Hearing his cousin's surprised voice, Lu Yang had a little pride on his face.Because he knew that when his cousin was in the army, he didn't even get a single "four things" when he finally left.So my cousin regretfully told him that being a soldier is like a snowball, falling behind step by step.As long as he had performed actively in the recruit company, served as deputy squad leader, and later joined the company as a teaching team, he would not have returned in despair after two years as a conscript.The cousin's voice on the other end was sour: "You kid, are you here to tease your brother? There are eight or nine people in a class, and you have outshined the rest?" Seeing that he didn't believe it, Lu Yang turned around and shouted into the dormitory.When he heard the voice coming from the other end of the phone: "Deputy squad leader, what's wrong?" My cousin was completely shocked: "No, brother, you, how did you get into the position of deputy squad leader?" Lu Yang laughed and said, "It's all what you taught me before. As soon as I entered the army, I performed actively and never stepped on any mistakes. The squad leader thought I was very smart.Spirit." Upon hearing this, his cousin raised his head once again and said, "Brother, do your best!Be the squad leader of the new recruit company, and be the squad leader of the lower company.I will go back to the military academy and become a platoon leader!" Lu Yang also borrowed his good words, which is the main reason why he has been actively striving for the top since he joined the army.The army is a place where as long as you work hard enough, you can get what you want.If you are physically fit, you can break records, participate in competitions, and win honors.If you are good at writing, you can write more articles and publish more, or you can help publish blackboard newspapers, and you can easily become a civil servant.If you know how to cook, the people in the cooking class are all vying for it. Even in the new training stage, even housekeeping and training are a piece of shit, and the platoon leader will smile when he sees you.Lu Yang knew that there was a recruit in Class 6 who graduated from New Oriental Chef School and had a chef certificate.From time to time, I would go to the cafeteria to help cook, and come back to bring food and drinks to the new recruits in the class.In their class, that soldier was almost like a star among the stars.So, don’t hide it when you come. The army is a stage where you can show off your skills.The cousin left, and the phone returned to his parents' hands. This time it was his father, Lu Yongqiang, who spoke.Unlike my mother, my father's care always seems more reserved, a bit formal and stiff."In the army, you have to listen to the squad leader, and you haven't had any conflicts with other people?" "No, everyone is fine." "The squad leader asked you to be the squad deputy because he trusts and values ​​you. You have to work harder in the future and don't be proud..." "Okay, okay, why are you telling your son this? Doesn't he know? Go, go to the side, I will talk to my son..." Lu Yang smiled warmly as he listened to his mother's tireless instructions and care on the other end of the phone.In the eyes of parents, children never grow up.When you are young and ignorant, you will never listen to your parents’ nagging.When you grow up, you gradually realize that no one in this world except your parents will treat you unconditionally and sincerely.The leftovers of society, the little pride of your parents, only your parents will care about whether you are tired, whether you are suffering, and whether you have eaten well.But when too many people truly understand this truth, they find that time has already stained their temples, bent their bodies, and blurred their appearance in your memory."Son, can you take a photo and send it over? When Mom misses you, you can take it out and have a look." "Mom, the army has regulations and you can't take random pictures." "Oh, that's right..." The mother on the other end was obviously a little disappointed, but Lu Yang told her."However, our squad leader said that he will take photos of us alone when we are about to go down to the next company. I can write a letter and send it back then." "Okay, okay, that's okay!" After a brief chat, they asked about the health of the elderly at home. After learning that everything was fine, Lu Yang felt more at ease.For Lu Yang, who was reborn, everything in the army was novel and unfamiliar.Everything I knew before came from the oral accounts of my cousin and his two comrades, as well as information found on the Internet.Fortunately, there is system assistance that can help him better explore and understand the new "life copy" of the army.This also made him look forward to the next life, especially the life after Xialian.Putting the phone back in his pocket, Lu Yang just returned to the dormitory when he saw Ding Tengfei taking pictures of the regulations with his phone.The moment the flash light came on, Lu Yang's pupils shrank suddenly and he rushed to stop it."What are you doing?!" "None of your business!" Ding Tengfei pulled Lu Yang aside and raised his hand to take two more pictures of the dormitory environment.But the next second, the phone was snatched away, and he was so angry that he went up to fight with Lu Yang."Fuck, are you looking for trouble? I don't have a mobile phone, give it back to me!" "Someone pull him away!" But before his fist could touch Lu Yang, he was restrained by several people.Ding Tengfei was so angry that he cursed loudly and struggled hard: "Let me go, bastard! If you don't let me go, I will kill you, you are all such dogs..." Kong Rong went up and said, "Shut up, I'll try to kill you again!" Ding Tengfei was pinned down on the bed by a group of people, but his mouth was as if it was poisoned, and the curses did not stop at all.Lu Yang ignored him at all and anxiously looked through Ding Tengfei's photo album and cell phone chat history.When he saw, "confidential" photos of the troops appeared in several dialog boxes.And that very stupid military uniform selfie in QQ space, and his face turned extremely ugly in an instant.Lu Yang turned his head and looked at Ding Tengfei, who was still struggling and shouting on the ground, and took a deep breath: "Ding Tengfei, you are dead, even if I come here, it will be useless. What I said..." Ding Tengfei's mouth remained unyielding: "Fuck you, you are scaring me, I am scared?!"
